# get-esim v1.0.2 Changelog

- Added new file: `.DS_Store`.
- Updated documentation to clarify that payment wallet addresses are provided dynamically by the API (do not hardcode payment addresses).
- Added details on API rate limiting (10 requests/min per IP, HTTP 429 with `Retry-After`).
- Removed hardcoded payment wallet addresses from public documentation tables.
- No core logic or functional changes; documentation and metadata update only.

- Added .gitignore and README.md files for improved codebase management and documentation.
- Updated SKILL.md to support both Base Mainnet (real eSIMs) and Base Sepolia (test/mock eSIMs), with guidance on how to specify the desired network.
- Revised the workflow and invocation instructions to include explicit network selection and clarify when to use mainnet versus testnet.
- Expanded API documentation to detail separate endpoints and payment information for mainnet and testnet environments.
- Improved example conversations to illustrate flows for both production (mainnet) and development/testing (testnet) use cases.

Initial release of Get eSIM Skill.

- Purchase eSIM data packages for any country using USDC on Base Sepolia testnet, via the x402 protocol.
- Supports two payment schemes: gasless (EIP-3009 "exact") and standard USDC transfer ("transfer").
- Returns a user-friendly installation page with QR code upon purchase completion.
- Includes guided workflow for discovering user needs, presenting data plans, confirming purchases, and handling x402 payments.
- Notifies users about transaction timing and progress.
